name: bitbot-plugin-access-sync
description: Disables Nextcloud accounts when the Central access role is lost, and re-enables them when it returns.
author: UVClay

guild_id.description: The Central guild whose role grants access.

role_id.description: The role that grants Nextcloud access.

nextcloud_user.description: Nextcloud service user (group admin of the groups below).

group.description: Nextcloud group of Fluxer-login users (the only accounts touched).

suspended_group.description: Marker group for accounts this plugin disabled.

dry_run.description: Log what would change instead of changing it.
